description: Films and series on an Xtream line (or an M3U's /movie/ and /series/ entries): with nothing else, the categories; with category, its titles; with query, a search of every title; with seriesId, that show's episodes. Films and episodes come with their stream URL.

category.description: Category id from the category list

playlist.description: Saved playlist name; defaults to the current one

query.description: Words that must all be in the title

seriesId.description: A show's seriesId, for its episodes

source.description: Use this playlist instead of a saved one: {type:"m3u", url} or {type:"xtream", server, username, password}; optional epg

name: movies_shows
title: Browse Movies and Shows
